name: Cantina Fantini
verdict: Wine brand of the Fantini Group of Ortona, Italy, owned by the US private-equity firm Platinum Equity since March 2020. Nothing found.
note: Jersey and shorts sponsor (the shirt reads CANTINA FANTINI; the team's partner page says 'Cantini Fantini'). Rating note: Platinum Equity is a private US firm; no state or state fund is sourced in the chain and no human-rights finding against the group was found.
